title: Internal Bleve index fields must be refused in every field-naming place in a search request
answers: Why does filtering/sorting on _deleted, _provisioned or _rv silently return no/wrong results?
How do I add validation for a new backend-only index field?
Why does my request to a search field return 400 instead of empty results?
Search field is internal, request should be rejected
body: Symptom: a request naming _deleted, _provisioned or _rv (fields mapped into the Bleve index for backend use only, never declared as search fields) got a 200 with a filter matching nothing, a sort ordering by nothing, or the field silently dropped from the response. Root cause: pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:toBleveSearchRequest built the query without checking field names against anything. Fix pattern: classify such names once in pkg/storage/unified/resource/standard_search_fields.go (internalSearchFieldNames / IsInternalSearchField), then call a single gate — rejectInternalFields in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go — at the top of toBleveSearchRequest, checking req.Fields, req.SortBy, req.QueryFields, req.Facet and req.Options.Fields (filters). Constraints: req.Options.Labels is deliberately excluded — a label key is user data, not an index field name, so an object may legitimately carry a label named like an internal field. When adding a new backend-only index field, add it to internalSearchFieldNames; when adding a new request shape that can name a field (a new filter/sort/facet kind), it must also be added to rejectInternalFields or the gate silently misses it.
applies: Any change to pkg/storage/unified/search or pkg/storage/unified/resource that adds a backend-only index field or a new way for a ResourceSearchRequest to name a field.
says: Why do filters and sorts on internal fields fail silently?
How do I add validation to reject requests for backend fields?
Why does a search request return an error instead of working?
How do I prevent users from filtering or sorting on internal fields?
search: Field names _deleted, _provisioned, and _rv must be rejected in every location where a ResourceSearchRequest can name a field in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:toBleveSearchRequest; if not validated, internal fields are silently dropped, match nothing, or disappear from responses. Define internalSearchFieldNames once in pkg/storage/unified/resource/standard_search_fields.go (IsInternalSearchField), then call rejectInternalFields gate at the top of toBleveSearchRequest to check req.Fields, req.SortBy, req.QueryFields, req.Facet, and req.Options.Fields; req.Options.Labels is deliberately excluded since label keys are user data, not index field names. When adding a new backend-only index field, add it to internalSearchFieldNames; when adding a new request shape that can name a field (new filter, sort, or facet kind), it must also be covered by rejectInternalFields or the gate silently misses it. Applies to any change in pkg/storage/unified/search or pkg/storage/unified/resource that adds a backend-only index field or a new way to name a field in a search request.
